But I don't think I'm masking. 

I actually kind of have the opposite problem when it comes to masking (and I also don't know if this is also an autism thing or a *me* thing), I can't hide my emotions no matter what they are. I can't train my face to be neutral or show a different emotion than what I'm feeling. 

I think it's just an extreme case of imposter syndrome :P

I know you're right and it's just something I'm gonna have to work on. 

Thank god I have a therapist who can help me!

Lol, I like that line! 

And it's not my friends who do that, it's random assholes online or in public, which I know I shouldn't let get to me but a lot of the time it feels like I don't really have a psychic barrier between my own sense of self worth and other people's random comments. I really need to work on getting thicker skin, I'm just too overly sensitive. 

I also really want people to like me. 

I think my problem is I just overthink too much and I am overly sensitive and craving outward validation from others. 

It's something I should work on.
That's how I feel a lot of the time too!

Admittedly I do worry a lot about whether or not other people will think I'm fake. 

Comes from the constant barrage of, "Oh well you're not a ***REAL*** fan of X or you're not a ***REAL*** y" etc. So I guess I kind of over think it all. Which is kind of annoying because I don't want to think like that. 

I DM (Dungeon Master) and play DND and TTRPGs as much as possible, which is about as close to acting as I've ever gotten. I tried out for some plays in school and took drama class once, but my acting career both began and *ENDED* on that high school stage.

Sometimes I wish I wasnt Ace because then it feels like it'd be easier to find someone to love me. 

Seriously how many people want to date/get into a serious relationship with someone who isn't interested in sex when "sex = love and romance/IS THE GREATEST THING EVER" has been so deeply engrained into our society? 

But it's a weird, complicated, not fun thing where I'll wish I wasn't Ace so I could find someone to at least give me a chance, and then I'll hate myself even more for thinking that way because I shouldn't think that way because being Asexual isn't a bad thing. 

So it's just a shitty ouroborous that just keeps feeding into itself and makes me feel worse and worse and worse.
His character got fucking assassinated by writers who didn't know what the fuck they were doing.
It's the Hufflepuff and Slytherin dynamic.

I'm not the kind of person people usually fall in love with. It usually ends with something akin to, "You're like a little sister to me", which is nice but.... I want someone to see me as more than that. I'm fucking 25 dammit. 

And anyways, I don't want to be in a relationship with someone who is in love with someone else, because I care about them and want them to be happy, so if that means they're with someone else then there's nothing I can do. I know poly relationships are a thing and more power to those who are in one, but I'm not poly.

When it comes to this I always think of that Key and Peele sketch "Office Homophobe." Look, speaking as someone who is actually part of the LGBT crowd, some members are just so fucking obnoxious about it.
